MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink bundle feels like a useful next step because I already have a Blink camera, and adding doorbell and indoor coverage would extend that setup.",
    "The Echo Show 8 fits my interest in connected home devices and gives me a reason to try Alexa with a display alongside my Fire TV and security equipment."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire tablets offer portable entertainment, but my recent choices center on watching at home, where I already have a television.",
    "Another Fire TV Stick adds little because I already have a 4K Stick and a Fire TV television; a themed remote cover does not create a new need.",
    "The smart plug relates to connected homes, but I have no particular appliance I want to automate."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning several Amazon devices seems to have been taken as interest in almost any Amazon device, even when its purpose does not fit my current needs.",
    "My interest in home entertainment seems to have been stretched into interest in tablets and additional streaming devices, without considering what I already own."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more interested in equipment that adds a useful capability, such as doorbell coverage, than another device that repeats something my setup already does.",
    "Several Alexa devices interest me, but I would choose the larger Echo Show 8 now rather than also choosing a smaller display or a speaker.",
    "Compatibility with my existing equipment matters when it serves a concrete purpose; sharing a brand alone is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my connected home interests but gave too much weight to shared branding and too little to the additional usefulness of each device."
}
